args.summary: Following the v2.3.1 production deploy, checkout-api began failing health checks. The service has been rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback rollout is complete and verified. v2.3.1 should not be re-deployed until the root cause of the failed health checks is investigated and remediated.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Reviewed deployment history** for checkout-api: v2.3.1 (production) was unhealthy; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback rollout completed and was verified.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failed health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: no re-deployment of v2.3.1 should occur until the root cause of the health check failures is addressed.
